create_secret_in_aws: create a python module to use AWSSecretsManagerGateway to create a secret in AWS Secrets Manager with a name and value
get_secret_from_aws: create a python module to use AWSSecretsManagerGateway to retrieve a secret by its ID from AWS Secrets Manager
delete_secret_from_aws: create a python module to use AWSSecretsManagerGateway to delete a secret by its ID from AWS Secrets Manager
convert_aws_response_to_secret: create a python module to use AWSSecretsManagerGateway to convert AWS describe and value responses into a StringSecret object
generate_aws_tags_dict: create a python module to use AWSSecretsManagerGateway to convert a tags dictionary into the AWS required list of Key-Value dicts
